objective: Discover/qualify/trace three consumer-separated live Skills bridge responsibilities without creating a parallel registry, transport layer or authority. Reuse native Skills source and test contracts.

nodes.label: SkillSourceAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Interpret configured Agent Skills sources and admit only evidence-scanned, appropriately trusted, context-eligible packages into a bounded candidate inventory; exclude malicious or unsuitable packages without making runtime Tool/Agent permission decisions.
nodes.authority: Skills source discovery and trust projection, not provider/platform permission
inputs: SkillSource config with scope/root/priority and discovery bounds
Skill package SKILL.md/resource bytes and user-audit/explicit-use flags
outputs: SkillRecord inventory, source scan diagnostics, trust/eligibility standings, source-bound package digests
behavioralContract: Quarantined/untrusted packages cannot enter the normal effective view; unknown eligibility is explicitly retained as unknown, not converted to proof of runnable tools.
Symbolic path escape/symlink and hostile package limits reject package reads at Skills boundary; package digest reflects scanned bytes, not installed execution truth.
acceptance: Native Skills owner test_skill_catalog_r2.py / test_skills_mcp_r2.py enforce trust, quarantine, filesystem bounds and package digest cases.
This is a SOURCE/Tool-qualified responsibility, not proof every arbitrary third-party Skill is safe.

consumers.claim: Eligible source inventory is filtered before scoped lookup

environment.source: Configured filesystem and optional plugins, scan snapshot
environment.installed: UNKNOWN until Skills deployment and connector identity are observed

formalObligations: Completeness of admitted package list is bounded by configured sources and scan errors
No quarantined Skill can become an effective normal lookup record

nodes.label: ContextualSkillDiscovery
nodes.responsibility: Project admitted Skill records into context- and invocation-specific discoverable candidates and deterministically resolve one Skill identity under existing precedence rules, preserving snapshot revision and shadowing.
nodes.authority: Skills catalog read-only derived projection, not a new Skill registry
inputs: workspaceId/agentId/physical workspace path and explicit-vs-implicit invocation
search query, requested name or canonical Skill ID, optional expected snapshot revision
outputs: Scoped SkillView/search results; canonical SkillResolution with shadowed candidates and snapshot digest; typed stale/not-found/not-visible errors
behavioralContract: Untrusted, quarantined, blocked or context-ineligible candidates cannot appear as admitted normal results.
Resolution is deterministic on one frozen inventory and caller context; stale expected snapshot must fail closed, never silently pick a different version.
Search uses bounded ranked lexical matching and does not prove semantic LEGO compatibility.
acceptance: Native catalog and MCP tests check shadowing, context, explicit/implicit eligibility, stale snapshot and unknown identity.
Discovery/search success does not grant execution authority or assert that a consumer executed an instruction.

consumers.claim: Exact skillId, scope and snapshot participate in resource read binding

environment.source: Exact contextual inventory snapshot and caller invocation mode
environment.installed: Gateway/client routing and deployed Skills service require separate Runtime/Connector observations

mustNotOwn: Semantic fitness of every search result
formalObligations: Snapshot revision equality is necessary before claiming read compatibility with previous resolution

nodes.label: BoundedSkillResourceRead
nodes.responsibility: Read bounded, immutable-source-qualified text resources for an exact admitted Skill identity with explicit instruction digest, package revision and optional context/snapshot fences, providing advisory sanitization with its own provenance.
nodes.authority: Skills native resource projection; underlying Git/filesystem package remains source owner
inputs: Canonical skillId and relative resource path
Optional expected instructionDigest, packageRevision and snapshotRevision
offset/maxBytes, advisory/raw projection and caller context
outputs: Bounded SkillReadResult with SHA-256 evidence of raw/projection bytes, exact package/instruction digests or typed failure
behavioralContract: Path traversal, symlink aliases, oversize reads and stale package/instruction/snapshot revisions fail closed.
Sanitized advisory text cannot be upgraded to a trusted runtime instruction; raw resource bytes remain source evidence only.
Actual Skill installation and execution are not inferred from successfully reading resource text.
acceptance: Native catalog tests falsify package drift, path escapes, digest mismatch and projection limits.
MCP Skills read tests consume the exact read result and error cases, without domain execution acceptance.

consumers.claim: Read-only bounded resource projection for Agent client

environment.source: Mounted/readable package path, current context and source digests
environment.installed: Client runtime/tool execution truth belongs to external consumer

mustNotOwn: Execute Skill scripts or promote third-party text to high-priority instructions
formalObligations: Bounded result must be linked to the exact package and instruction witness; Source evidence is not installed/executed proof

edges.label: admitted source inventory for bounded context selection
trust/quarantine, package safety remain prerequisites of exact reads
resolved exact identity and source-context fence for bounded reads

gaps: Formal checker has not proven Skills scan/resolve/read code refinement for all OS/races/dynamic clients.
Installed/configured/executed/consumer currentness is external to this SOURCE-qualified planning projection.
No claim that these three identities exhaust all Skills implementation details or other Agent Skill consumers.
retirementPolicy: Any responsibility with no distinguishable consumer contract is an internal detail; move to mature Agent Skills/Agent Plugins/MCP standards where they completely satisfy the observed behavior.
